subject: Onboarding SOW & SLA amendment request — HelixHealth
messages:
From: HelixHealth Contracts <contracts@helixhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOW & onboarding + premium support request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We reviewed the implementation plan with our engineering team and need two items added to the standard onboarding SOW: a custom EHR integration connector (HL7-based) and premium onboarding (white-glove training + 2-week on-site slice). Our procurement lead asked whether Redwood can include premium onboarding in the first-year bundle and provide a reduced onboarding fee given a 24-month commitment.

Timeline: production by 2027-02-15.
Key asks:
- Add integration scope (estimated 40 engineering hours plus testing)
- Include premium onboarding package (onsite, three training sessions, dedicated SE hours during ramp)
- Discount on onboarding fees or a one-time credit tied to a 24-month ARR commitment

Attached: rough internal SOW template and our contract redline notes. Please advise next steps and an updated SOW draft.

Regards,
Daniel Park
Procurement Manager, HelixHealth
[Attachment: Helix_Internal_Redlines.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 120 KB)]
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOW & onboarding + premium support request

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear outline. I attached a draft SOW that folds the HL7 connector and the premium onboarding bundle into year one and included preliminary pricing.

Quick notes:
- Draft assumes a 24-month term for the commercial credit. If signed, Redwood can offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 20% of the onboarding line item (we can discuss increasing this but would need exec sign-off).
- Integration scope in the SOW includes 40 eng hours + a test plan; any additional engineering change requests will be billed per the ratecard.
- Delivery milestone: EHR connector staged in staging environment within 8 weeks of kickoff, production after acceptance testing.

Attaching: SOW_Draft_v2.pdf and our Onboarding_Ratecard.xlsx.

Marissa — looping you in for approval on the onboarding credit and the waiver on the standard integration retainer. Per our current guidelines, this is a non-standard concession (discount + bundled premium support). Can you advise?

Thanks,
Karthik
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_Draft_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 245 KB)]
[Attachment: Onboarding_Ratecard.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 78 KB)]
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-04T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SOW & onboarding + premium support request — need exec exception approval

Karthik — thanks for the draft. Internal notes for the approvers:

Summary of concession requested:
- One-time onboarding credit of 20% applied to onboarding line item (K is asking for 30% but he flagged he needs approval)
- Waive the standard $12k integration retainer and bill only hours as consumed per ratecard included in the SOW
- Include premium onboarding (onsite) at no additional monthly admin fee for year 1

Financial impact:
- ARR: $720k net ARR over 24 months (est)
- One-time revenue giveback: onboarding credit ~ $18k (at 20% level) + waived $12k retainer = ~$30k immediate revenue concession
- Upside: 24-month commitment increases predictable revenue and potential expansion across 3 lines of business at HelixHealth

Recommendation: Approve the concession at the 20% onboarding credit (not 30%) and require a binding 24-month minimum term and a documented change-control clause for scope creep. Also require a separate clause for acceptance criteria tied to staging->prod signoff.

Monica — need you to confirm whether CS/Onboarding can absorb the on-site premium onboarding for the timeframe requested (Feb). Rishi — legal quirk: can we avoid modifying core SLA but add a service level amendment for onboarding deliverables?

Please reply with APPROVE / DENY / APPROVE WITH CHANGES so Karthik can send final SOW to Helix.

- Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SOW & onboarding + premium support request — need exec exception approval

APPROVE WITH CHANGES

Monica's notes:
- Onboarding capacity: we can commit to the 2-week on-site in Feb provided Helix finalizes kickoff by 2027-01-10. If kickoff slips, we will convert to remote intensive sessions.
- Discount level: approve the 20% onboarding credit as the max concession. If Karthik strongly prefers 30%, that requires CRO sign-off.
- Integration work: we will absorb the 40 eng hours for standard integration testing but any additional custom work billed per the ratecard. We require a change-control workflow in the SOW to capture scope increases and approvals.
- SLA amendment: acceptable as a separate schedule; do not change platform uptime SLA.

Condition for approval to go to customer: include a signed 24-month commitment (term clause) and milestone-based payment schedule (30% kickoff, 40% on staging signoff, 30% on production).

Monica Patel
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-06T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final SOW & commercial terms — next steps

Daniel — thanks for the patience. Per our internal approvals, Redwood can proceed with the following binding commercial terms:

- 24-month committed term (HLX-2026-0421)
- One-time onboarding credit: 20% of onboarding line item (applied at invoice)
- Waived $12k integration retainer; integration billed at time-and-materials per ratecard (40 hours assumed for initial connector)
- Premium onboarding (2-week on-site + 3 training sessions) included in year 1
- Milestone payment schedule: 30% kickoff / 40% staging signoff / 30% production acceptance

I attached the revised SOW with the amendment schedule and the DocuSign link to sign. Please review and sign the SOW. Once signed, CS will schedule the kickoff and SEs will begin work on the connector.

DocuSign: https://redwoodapp.app/docuSign/HLX-SOW-0421

Thanks — looking forward to getting Helix live.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_Draft_v2_revised.pdf (application/pdf, 268 KB)]
